name: exposure_confirmation

nearby.construction: independently simulated reservoir events assigned one-to-one by maximum bipartite matching inside a state-distance quantile band

arms.B: 64 independent replacement trajectories under fresh appearances
arms.C: the 64 source trajectories under appearances unique within the block
arms.D: one independent neighbor per source, closer than anything in base training: RMS state distance in [0.25, 0.5] x the source's nearest base-training distance
arms.D2: one reservoir-selected independent neighbor per source in the 0.1st-1st percentile band of pairwise independent distances (comparable to base-training nearest neighbors)
arms.E: the exact renders forming the exact population (diagnostic reference, not a ceiling)

populations.source: 4 held-out renders per source trajectory, unseen by every arm
populations.exact: the render E trains on; unseen by B, C, and D
populations.independent: 512 independently sampled trajectories under fresh appearances

exposure_dose: 800 arm-slot presentations over 64 sources: 12 or 13 presentations per source
primary_metric: mean over examples of per-disk-frame Euclidean center error, capped at 1 arena width; nonfinite outputs receive the cap
seed_derivation: numpy SeedSequence(entropy=experiment_seed, spawn_key=(block_index,)) spawned into data, schedule, base_batches, torch roles

decision_contract.interval: 95% two-sided t interval over block-level paired contrasts

outcomes.prevalence_dependent: lower(G) > 0.002 and not consequential; report break-even prevalence interval [m/upper(G), m/lower(G)]
outcomes.inconclusive: none of the above; report the failing gate

secondary.identity_specific: lower(Q) > 0.010, where Q = (L_D,source - L_C,source) - (L_D,indep - L_C,indep) and D is the closer-than-base-training neighbor arm
secondary.harm_flag: lower(H) > 0.001 reported as consequential independent-event harm
secondary.multiplicity: Holm across secondary claims; distance bands and detectors exploratory
secondary.banded_neighbor: Q2 for arm D2 reported descriptively

freeze_requirement: Configuration SHA-256 recorded in a freeze manifest with sign-off from the paper lead and Yining Hua before --unblind is permitted.
claim_boundary: Effect of replacing 64 independent continuation events with same-trajectory rerenders for this ConvLSTM, dose, and continuation phase.
sample_size_rationale: 256 blocks. The harm gate is binding: per-block independent-population differences between two random continuations have SD about 0.0015 (pilot v4; S-H correlation -0.96), while the reuse gap cancels this shared shift. Using pilot v4 80% upper SD limits, joint consequential-rule power is 1.00 at H=0 and 0.97 at H=0.0005 (half the margin); 0.73 if SDs are 1.5x larger at H=0.0005. Test size at the threshold is about 0.025. Runtime about 3.5 hours on Apple MPS (50 s per block). See results/confirmation_power.json.
base_competence_screen: Pre-treatment screen: a block enters the primary analysis iff its base model's bounded error on the block's independent population is below that population's constant-velocity error. All blocks are reported; an intent-to-treat analysis over every completed block is a sensitivity analysis.

closer_nearby.construction: independent events conditioned on RMS state distance between 0.25 and 0.5 of the source's nearest base-training distance; uniform proposals over a sensitivity-scaled box (edge offset alone gives 6x the band maximum, capped at half the range) within the uniform initial-state prior, accepted by distance band
closer_nearby.containment_validation: Doubling test (multiplier 3 vs 6, 600 neighbors each): per-parameter offset distributions agree; 6 is used.
